<div class="biography">
  <h3>Bio.</h3>
  <p>I am an Assistant Professor at the Department of Informatics, Faculty of Sciences, 
  University of Lisbon, and a researcher at LASIGE, contributing to the Health and Biomedical Informatics 
  and Data and Systems Intelligence research lines.</p>
  <p>My research lies at the intersection of computational innovation and impactful healthcare applications. 
  I am focusing on unsupervised learning, particularly subspace clustering, and pattern-centric representation learning.</p>
  <p>I am motivated by problems in patient stratification, disease-progression modeling, 
  and improving clinical decision support systems.</p>
  <hr>
  <p><a href="https://www.lasige.pt">LASIGE</a> and Department of Informatics, <a href="https://www.ciencias.ulisboa.pt">Ciências Ulisboa</a></p>
